newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - December 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

No agreement has been reached as yet on leasing the Queen Elizabeth quay to a P&O led consortium, says Ports and Shipping minister M.H.M.Ashraff. The minister was speaking to port workers who have threatened strike action against the proposed leasing.
A 50 billion rupee garbage disposal plant to be set up at Welisara north of Colombo, with World Bank and Chinese aid.

A final decision is yet to be made on leasing the Queen Elizabeth quay, Ports and Shipping minister Ashraff told trade unionion, which have threatened to strike in protest at the leasing. Any strike action, would therfore be construed as a step to disrupt normal functions of the port, he said.
Police find bombs and grenades hidden in a shop in Colombo's Pettah area. The owner of the establishment has been taken in for questioning, a senior police official said.
Police question French national in connection with 10,000 kg of hashish found in a trawler off the northern Chilaw coast, earlier this week, police sources say.
Education minister Richard pathirana warns that those found ragging new students, will be expelled. There have been a number of instances where students have been seriously injured during ragging.
